mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit to widen a doorway in Denver, Centennial, or Parker?

acceptedAnswer.text: For Denver and nearby South Denver metro communities, permits matter because changing the size of a doorway opening can require residential remodel approval. That is especially relevant in places like Centennial, Greenwood Village, Foxfield, and Parker where homeowners often combine accessibility updates with other interior remodeling.
acceptedAnswer.description: If the size of the doorway opening changes, a permit may be required. This is especially important in Denver-area residential remodel work, so it is worth confirming before the wall is opened up.
